eventClockRule: Product latency uses monotonic content-free signposts on the named device. Wall-clock timestamps correlate artifacts only. XCTest duration is never a product latency source.

measures.startEvent: user tap on the global composer
measures.stopEvent: editable composer accepts committed input
measures.device: supported physical iPhone; report each model and OS separately
measures.evidence: content-free OS signpost trace plus synchronized screen recording
measures.aggregation: P50 and P95 by device across warm and cold launches
measures.missingReason: No physical iPhone was connected and the current app lacks the frozen content-free signpost trace.
measures.nextProof: Collect at least 30 warm and 30 cold interactions per supported physical device without using XCTest duration.

measures.startEvent: intentional source selection completes
measures.stopEvent: device-owned source preview becomes inspectable
measures.device: supported physical iPhone
measures.evidence: content-free signpost trace and accepted source-preview recording
measures.aggregation: P50, P90, and P95 by source type and device
measures.missingReason: The frozen run entered a synthetic fixture rather than measuring the device-owned source-selection path.
measures.nextProof: Measure image, text, file, and voice previews on physical devices with identical synthetic sources.

measures.startEvent: Intent ID is created after Send or source selection
measures.stopEvent: the first explicitly provisional source-local interpretation is visible and readable
measures.device: supported physical iPhone under frozen network conditions
measures.evidence: Intent/task event trace, content-free signposts, and synchronized recording
measures.aggregation: P50 and P90 for ordinary scenarios, stratified by source type and network
measures.missingReason: The current product has no V2 source-local first-read state and no physical-device trace was collected.
measures.nextProof: Instrument the future two-speed response and compare the same frozen sources without blocking on context resolution.

measures.startEvent: authorized contextual snapshot is pinned
measures.stopEvent: the governed contextual Brief is visible with evidence references
measures.device: supported physical iPhone with frozen backend, provider, locale, and network
measures.evidence: Task event trace separated into local, network, provider, and control-plane spans
measures.aggregation: P50 and P90 on the ordinary path, with provider failures reported separately
measures.missingReason: The typed Momentum Brief does not exist in the current baseline.
measures.nextProof: Measure only after MX-05 defines the shared Brief and exact ready event.

measures.startEvent: authenticated app foreground after relaunch
measures.stopEvent: protected current Task projection is visible or a truthful recovery state is shown
measures.device: supported physical iPhone
measures.evidence: content-free launch and projection signposts plus relaunch recording
measures.aggregation: P50, P90, and maximum across ordinary recovery fixtures
measures.missingReason: The frozen UI run tested cancellation recovery but not physical relaunch timing from protected Task projection.
measures.nextProof: Run termination and relaunch with one stable Intent and inspect both local and server projection identities.

measures.startEvent: participant first sees the synthetic source
measures.stopEvent: participant reaches an observed Receipt or a truthful no-action terminal and correctly states the outcome
measures.device: same physical device and comparator environment assigned by randomized crossover
measures.evidence: moderator event trace, screen recording, and destination or no-action readback
measures.aggregation: median paired time and paired ratio with 95 percent bootstrap interval
measures.missingReason: No representative recruiter crossover study has run.
measures.nextProof: Execute the frozen Talent Signal, Ailoha, and manual protocols with randomized order.

measures.startEvent: tap, Send, decision, or recovery intent is emitted
measures.stopEvent: a visible pressed, focused, progress, or state-transition response appears
measures.device: supported physical iPhone
measures.evidence: high-frame-rate screen recording correlated with content-free signposts
measures.aggregation: P95 by interaction class
measures.missingReason: Simulator XCTest timing cannot establish physical interaction feedback.
measures.nextProof: Capture each ordinary interaction on physical devices at a declared frame rate.

measures.startEvent: authorized request leaves the client boundary
measures.stopEvent: the complete response or terminal network failure reaches the client
measures.device: physical device and frozen backend environment
measures.evidence: content-free network span joined by Task and attempt identity
measures.aggregation: P50 and P90 by endpoint and network profile
measures.missingReason: The core simulator fixture ran locally without the ordinary contextual network path.
measures.nextProof: Freeze Wi-Fi and constrained-network profiles and report network separately from UI and provider time.

measures.startEvent: authorized model request is dispatched
measures.stopEvent: validated model response or provider terminal failure is received
measures.device: frozen backend/provider environment
measures.evidence: content-free provider span containing no prompt or private payload
measures.aggregation: P50 and P90 by model and response path
measures.missingReason: Deterministic replay used frozen provider events and cannot represent live model latency.
measures.nextProof: Run the same authorized synthetic cases with a declared provider and preserve only content-free timing.

measures.startEvent: fixture review opens
measures.stopEvent: exact source evidence is visible
measures.device: iPhone 17 Pro Simulator, iOS 26.5
measures.evidence: accepted TS-CORE-01 entrance screenshot and scripted UI trace
measures.aggregation: count per attempt; report median and maximum in comparative study
measures.claimBoundary: The direct synthetic fixture shows evidence without a prior Person or Pursuit choice; it does not represent first-launch source import.

measures.startEvent: participant first receives the source
measures.stopEvent: verified result or truthful no-action terminal
measures.device: same study device and comparator environment
measures.evidence: moderator-coded input trace with semantic field labels and no private text
measures.aggregation: median and P90 by comparator
measures.missingReason: The automated fixture uses predetermined taps and cannot represent recruiter re-entry burden.
measures.nextProof: Code repeated semantic entry in the crossover study before unblinding results.

measures.startEvent: participant chooses the intended next move
measures.stopEvent: the destination screen or object identity is visible
measures.device: same study device and comparator environment
measures.evidence: screen recording and exact destination object readback
measures.aggregation: wrong destinations divided by eligible attempts with exact confidence interval
measures.missingReason: Scripted assertions establish one intended destination but not first-use recruiter error rate.
measures.nextProof: Code first, fifth, and final target selection without prompting in the blinded study.

measures.unit: proportion of attempts with one or more user corrections
measures.startEvent: first system interpretation is visible
measures.stopEvent: fact review closes or remains unresolved
measures.device: same study device and comparator environment
measures.evidence: content-free Confirm, Edit, Dismiss, and correction-reason events
measures.aggregation: attempt-level rate plus corrections per attempt
measures.direction: contextual; lower is better only when seeded-error detection does not fall
measures.missingReason: No blinded seeded-error participant run exists.
measures.nextProof: Report both necessary-error detection and unnecessary-correction burden.

measures.startEvent: participant begins the assigned scenario
measures.stopEvent: verified result, truthful no-action, explicit abandonment, or protocol timeout
measures.device: same study device and comparator environment
measures.evidence: moderator event trace and terminal state
measures.aggregation: abandoned attempts divided by starts with exact confidence interval
measures.missingReason: Automated tests cannot establish human abandonment.
measures.nextProof: Freeze the protocol timeout and abandonment reason codes before participant enrollment.

measures.startEvent: lead state becomes fully visible
measures.stopEvent: five seconds elapse and the participant answers what changed, why it matters, and what happens next
measures.device: same study device and comparator environment
measures.evidence: blinded response coded against a preregistered three-part rubric
measures.aggregation: all three parts correct divided by participants, with exact confidence interval
measures.missingReason: No first-use participant panel was available.
measures.nextProof: Run the five-second clarity test without exposing design rationale.

measures.startEvent: participant begins an effect-eligible or internal-outcome scenario
measures.stopEvent: destination observation and canonical Receipt agree, or an exact no-action terminal is verified
measures.device: same study device and comparator environment
measures.evidence: canonical readback plus destination observation joined by stable operation identity
measures.aggregation: verified completions divided by eligible attempts, stratified by effect class
measures.missingReason: The frozen core UI performs only a local handoff and the effect adapter replay is not EventKit destination proof.
measures.nextProof: Run one production-shaped Calendar effect with exact approval and destination observation.

measures.startEvent: user cancels a delayed synthetic import
measures.stopEvent: the source-free retry entrance becomes reachable
measures.device: iPhone 17 Pro Simulator, iOS 26.5
measures.evidence: CandidateSignalUITests/testImportCancellationAndRecovery() in the frozen xcresult
measures.aggregation: successful scripted recoveries divided by scripted attempts
measures.claimBoundary: One cancellation path only; offline termination and relaunch were not tested.

measures.unit: proportion of participants preferring Talent Signal
measures.startEvent: participant completes all randomized comparator conditions
measures.stopEvent: participant records forced-choice reuse preference and reason
measures.device: same study device and comparator environment
measures.evidence: blinded post-crossover questionnaire
measures.aggregation: preference against each comparator with exact binomial confidence interval
measures.missingReason: Ailoha direct access and representative participants were unavailable.
measures.nextProof: Collect forced-choice preference only after all three conditions are completed.

measures.startEvent: system proposes or attempts a Person binding
measures.stopEvent: canonical binding, abstention, or terminal failure is observed
measures.device: all frozen runtime and UI surfaces
measures.evidence: scenario oracle, canonical Person and Pursuit readback, and reviewer adjudication
measures.aggregation: wrong or unsupported bindings divided by eligible attempts; every blocker shown individually
measures.missingReason: The P0 deterministic subset passed but the required same-name human workflow evidence is absent.
measures.nextProof: Human-adjudicate every identity blocker and run current iOS readback on exact Person and Pursuit IDs.

measures.startEvent: decision-relevant claim becomes visible
measures.stopEvent: its exact authorized source, attribution, time, and current authority are inspected
measures.device: all frozen runtime and UI surfaces
measures.evidence: claim-to-evidence trace plus source authorization readback
measures.aggregation: unsupported, stale, wrong-speaker, or unavailable-authority claims divided by claims
measures.missingReason: Several P0 anchors need human review and TS-ID-02 did not complete its runner contract.
measures.nextProof: Adjudicate every blocker scenario at message level and inspect deletion and stale authority.

measures.startEvent: exact effect approval is recorded
measures.stopEvent: destination observation or explicit unknown outcome is reconciled
measures.device: physical iPhone and declared Calendar destination
measures.evidence: effect ledger, stable operation ID, EventKit observation, and canonical Receipt
measures.aggregation: unauthorized, duplicate, wrong-target, or false-success effects divided by eligible attempts
measures.missingReason: No physical EventKit destination run occurred and TS-ACT-04 supplemental replay failed.
measures.nextProof: Run ACT-01 through ACT-04 against the production-shaped Calendar adapter and inspect destination state.

measures.startEvent: the frozen P0 evaluation suite begins
measures.stopEvent: all twelve deterministic scenario gates complete
measures.device: local deterministic evaluation runner on the frozen repository worktree
measures.evidence: evidence/evaluation-summary.json#p0Run
measures.aggregation: count of deterministic safety failures across the suite
measures.claimBoundary: All twelve still require human workflow review and this count is not release approval.

measures.startEvent: the nineteen-case MX-00 scenario audit begins
measures.stopEvent: each required scenario has direct evidence, an observed failure, or an exact named gap
measures.device: frozen repository, evaluation runner, and iOS Simulator evidence set
measures.evidence: scenario-bank.json
measures.aggregation: scenarios with an inspectable status and next proof divided by nineteen
measures.claimBoundary: Coverage means every scenario is accounted for; it does not mean every scenario passed or ran end to end.
